hypothesis: Quality Flow is a 4H breakout/continuation system. Continuation works when institutional sponsorship is already behind the name; trailing relative strength vs SPY is the simplest PIT proxy for 'the market is already rewarding this stock'.
mechanism: Breakouts in stocks being accumulated relative to the market should follow through more often than breakouts in laggards fighting for attention.
bucketing: quartile primary (top 25% / middle 50% / bottom 25%), tercile robustness; cross-sectional rank on the 123-name working universe, strict PIT
blinding: 14 names masked from construction, ranking, evaluation
